Name: Hunters Weald
Author: EttinoModdedSail
Description:
Brings Hunting into Stardew Valley... or at least that is the plan for this mod in the future. Currently this mod just adds the basic items i felt that it needs to be something, as this is the first mod I've made. Updates may be slow as im only working on this a limited time each week and still have a lot to learn about modding.

Currently this mod adds the meat, which can be purchased from Pierre, and recipes to cook them. first plans are to create new monsters which can be hunted for their meat rather than having to buy it from Pierre. These meats can then be roasted in the new oven using coal, or used in recipes, currently all of them are unlocked by default.
